title: Eiffel Tower director faces turmoil after sidelining of female staff at request of Hindu delegation
subhead: The exclusion of female staff members during a visit by members of an ultra-conservative Hindu religious group, sparked a strike and two investigations. Above all, the incident exposed the underlying unease within the company that runs the Iron Lady: contested management, social tensions and a lack of effective political oversight.

Paris childcare worker convicted of sexually assaulting nine children
subhead: Michaël M. was found guilty of sexually assaulting nine children, aged 5 to 10, from 2022 to 2024. He was sentenced to one year of house arrest with an ankle tag, a four-year suspended prison sentence and a ban on working with children.

title: After summer of unprecedented heatwaves and drought, climate activists rally support ahead of French elections
subhead: NGOs and unions have called for a demonstration on Tuesday outside the Finance Ministry to demand urgent climate action. On September 26, 200 protests are planned across France 'for the climate, living things, peace and social justice.'

title: French tourists travel less while record number of internationals visit France
subhead: International visitor numbers and revenues rose this summer, but fewer French people traveled in July and August. The French have shortened their getaways and cut back on spending due to the higher cost of living and recent heatwaves.

title: When the French far right raises the specter of a culinary 'great replacement'
subhead: In a country where gastronomy is a source of national pride, food – long overlooked as a political issue – has now been taken up by far-right movements for identity-driven and xenophobic purposes, in the name of protecting against the 'onslaught of multiculturalism.'

subhead: 'The Putin System' (1/3). The many 'siloviki,' officers drawn from Russia's security services, have seized power and are now omnipresent among the country's elites. Within society, they have spread an atmosphere of fear and suspicion that prohibits any questioning of the Kremlin or its war in Ukraine.

title: 'With the Le Pens, family always comes first': Marine Le Pen launches campaign surrounded by relatives and loyalists
subhead: Following the Le Pen tradition, the far-right candidate launched her fourth presidential campaign in the company of close friends and family members on Sunday. Supporters of the party's number two, Jordan Bardella, were sidelined or lost influence.

title: Poll: Le Pen begins presidential campaign in strongest position ever amid worried, angry electorate
subhead: In France's polarized political landscape, Marine Le Pen of the far-right Rassemblement National is enjoying unprecedented support, and radical left candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon is building a strong base. Wide open for other candidates, the race is drawing significant interest from voters concerned about the future, Le Monde's first poll shows.
